description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Only 100 Yards to the Beach* Private Pool and Hot Tub* Stunning Gulf Views; Outdoor Patio with Grill* 4 Bikes Included* 1 mile to Rosemary Beach; Less than a mile to Camp Helen State Park* Snorkel the Grouper Reef- more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions. * * Fits 2 cars in the driveway.*We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs January thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to Inlet Beach Retreat — your luxurious coastal escape just 100 yards from the pristine sands of Inlet Beach and moments from the charm of Rosemary Beach. Spanning over 3,000 square feet, this elegant home offers five spacious bedrooms and five full bathrooms, comfortably accommodating up to 12 guests. With stunning Gulf views, refreshing sea breezes, and top-tier amenities, you're set for an unforgettable beachside getaway. The ground level features a cozy guest suite complete with a Murphy bed, a kitchenette, a queen sleeper sofa, and a 42-inch HDTV. This space opens directly onto the lanai, where a private pool and spa await. Also on this floor is a lively game room with ping pong table — ideal for fun family nights. Upstairs, you'll find two beautifully appointed master bedrooms, each with a king bed, en-suite bath, smart TV, and a private porch with peek-a-boo Gulf views. A charming bunk room with built-in twin bunks and an additional full bath completes this level, offering flexible sleeping arrangements for kids or guests. The top floor is designed for gathering and relaxing. The open-concept living and dining area flows seamlessly onto a covered balcony with sweeping Gulf views. Enjoy movie nights on the 65-inch smart HDTV with Blu-ray player while lounging on the Italian leather sectional. The gourmet kitchen is a chef’s dream, featuring a Wolf gas oven, Subzero refrigerator, Cuisinart cookware, Keurig and drip coffee makers, and everything else you could need. Guest Bedroom 5 is also located on this floor, offering a king bed, en-suite bath, and a large private balcony with seating and more beautiful Gulf views.The private pool and spa are ideal for morning swims or lazy afternoons in the sun. The walled courtyard and covered open-air lanai create the perfect setting for outdoor relaxation and evening grilling — perfect for nights when you'd rather dine in. Come create unforgettable memories at Inlet Beach Retreat, where luxury meets comfort in one of the most beautiful stretches of Florida’s Gulf Coast.Inlet Beach is South Walton's easternmost and most untouched beach neighborhood. Boasting the largest public beach access point in South Walton and easy access to both Rosemary Beach and Carillon Beach nearby, it will provide you with a load of options. Donut Hole has now opened an Inlet Beach location, and there are local favs for a casual meal such as The Terrace or Shades at the Loop. Hop on some bikes and go check out Old World style Rosemary Beach or enjoy lounging in the sun. Whatever you choose for your beach vacation, you can't go wrong with Inlet Beach.The Bed Setup:1st Floor Guest Bedroom 1: Full Murphy Bed and Queen Sofa Bed2nd Floor Master Bedroom 1: King Bed Master Bedroom 2: King BedGuest Bedroom 3: Twin over Twin Bunk Bed3rd FloorGuest Bedroom: King BedArea Attractions: Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old-World style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys Beach. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid-back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play, and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
